Six free scenery ideas for Neon Apex

Creator previews, not in-game screenshots. Nothing added to the game. Checked 16 September 2026.

1. Volcano

SDC PERFORMANCE · CC BY · credit required

A stronger landmark for the mountain skyline. Smoke and lava animation would need checking separately.

Blender 2.9 · 15.4k triangles

Quaternius · CC0

Kenney · CC0

6. Passing trains

Quaternius · CC0

My first picks: 1 + 3 + 6. The volcano, forest ruins and a passing train would give different parts of the map their own landmarks.

CC0: commercial reuse and modification allowed without required credit. CC BY: credit the creator, link the license, and note changes. Asset licenses are listed on the linked creator pages. Download and runtime compatibility have not been tested. Quaternius lists Blender files; the volcano creator specifies Blender 2.9; Kenney’s pack is listed as 3D.
